source: bltlab/queryner (CC BY 4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/bltlab/queryner), train split 7,841 queries read via the datasets-server API; test split 993 queries (2 usable cases)
tier: T3 for product-type versus modifier recognition only (human span labels); not a consumer-need benchmark
rules: product case: alias inside a core_product_type span (raw, pre-run rule); exact-span: the human core_product_type span equals the alias (post-run correction: the raw rule counted toaster inside toaster oven and pepper/belt grinders as coffee-grinder cases)
notProductExamples: microwave with convection oven grill and air fryer
